div.span: - Toxics on Toxiproxy (latency, partitions) through toxiproxy-cli or the API on port 8474.
- The replication mode of the nodes (ap or cp), the CHECK_INTER of HAProxy and the WARMUP_SECONDS of a node.
- Writes and per-replica reads go straight to a node on host ports 18001 to 18003.
